limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses mouse models (C1q KO, C3 KO, DBA/2J glaucoma model); findings may not directly translate to humans.
Electrophysiological input counting may underestimate the real number of inputs.
The study does not identify the synaptic receptor for C1q.
The mechanism by which complement tags specific synapses for elimination is not fully elucidated.

missed_core_items.source_excerpt: We found that C1q mRNA levels were highest in postnatal RGCs between P5 and P10 and declined significantly by P30 (Figures 1B and 1C).

missed_core_items.description: C1q protein is localized to synapses in the developing CNS, including retina, cortex, and dLGN, and is developmentally downregulated.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: C1q immunoreactivity is localized to synapses throughout the postnatal, but not adult, brain and retina.

missed_core_items.description: C1q KO mice show no difference in RGC number or spontaneous retinal activity compared to controls.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: there was no difference in the number of cells in the peripheral or central regions of whole-mount retinas between C1q KO and controls (Figure S2A).

missed_core_items.source_excerpt: these mice still undergo some degree of synaptic refinement and synaptic pruning, indicating that complement-independent synapse elimination also occurs.

research_questions.statement: Does the classical complement cascade mediate CNS synapse elimination during development?

provenance.text_excerpt: Consistent with our hypothesis, C3 KOs displayed defects in eye-specific segregation and synapse elimination that closely mimic the C1q KO phenotype.

claims.statement: C3 is necessary for developmental synapse elimination, and its absence phenocopies C1q deficiency.

provenance.text_excerpt: If C1q is required for synapse elimination, then an increase in synapse number would be expected in its absence.

claims.statement: C1q is required for normal developmental synapse elimination in the retinogeniculate pathway.

evidence_spans.content: C1q KO mice exhibit sustained defects in eye-specific segregation and increased number of functional inputs to dLGN neurons.

provenance.text_excerpt: C1q KOs exhibit significant and sustained defects in retinogeniculate synaptic refinement that cannot be attributed to a change in RGC number or early patterned activity.

evidence_spans.content: C3 KO mice show similar defects in eye-specific segregation and synaptic refinement as C1q KO mice.

provenance.text_excerpt: C3 KOs displayed defects in eye-specific segregation and synapse elimination that closely mimic the C1q KO phenotype.

experiments_or_tasks: Anterograde tracing to assess eye-specific segregation in dLGN of C1q KO and C3 KO mice at P10 and P30.
Electrophysiological recordings from dLGN neurons in acute brain slices of P30 mice to measure number of functional retinogeniculate inputs.

methods.name: Anterograde tracing
methods.protocol_description: Injections of anterograde tracers into the eye to label RGC projections, followed by analysis of overlap in dLGN using multi-threshold method.

methods.name: Patch-clamp electrophysiology
methods.protocol_description: Whole-cell patch-clamp recordings from dLGN relay neurons in acute brain slices; incremental stimulation of optic tract to recruit individual RGC axons.

study_units.name: Developmental synapse elimination in C1q and C3 knockout mice

provenance.text_excerpt: The majority of C3 KO cells were classified as resolving (77%) rather than refined (23%), compared to WT cells, which are mostly refined by this age (Figure 6E, C3 KO n = 13, WT n = 30, p = 0.006).

results.value_raw_text: 77% of C3 KO cells were classified as resolving, 23% as refined; WT cells were mostly refined.

results.metric_name: Percentage of overlapping projections in dLGN (C3 KO)

provenance.text_excerpt: C3 KO mice had significant defects in eye-specific segregation, both at P10 and P30 (Figures 6B–6D). Quantification of the percentage of dLGN occupied by overlapping retinal axons from both eyes indicates that C3 KO mice, much like C1q KOs, had significantly more overlapping projections than age-matched and littermate controls.

results.value_raw_text: C3 KO mice had significantly more overlapping projections than controls at P10 and P30.

results.metric_name: Percentage of overlapping projections in dLGN

provenance.text_excerpt: We quantified these data using an established multi-threshold method of analysis (Torborg and Feller, 2004; Bjartmar et al., 2006) and found that the dLGNs of P10 C1q KO mice had a significantly higher percentage of overlapping projections, independent of threshold (Figure 4B).

results.value_raw_text: C1q KO mice had a significantly higher percentage of overlapping projections at P10 and P30 compared to controls.

results.metric_name: Number of functional inputs per dLGN neuron

provenance.text_excerpt: We found that the majority of WT cells received one or two inputs, whereas the majority of C1q KO cells were innervated by four or more inputs (Figure S4A, C1q KO = 4 ± 0.3 inputs, WT = 2.2 ± 0.2 inputs, p < 0.001).

results.value_raw_text: C1q KO neurons had an average of 4 ± 0.3 inputs, WT had 2.2 ± 0.2 inputs (p < 0.001).

provenance.text_excerpt: C1q is expressed at early stages of glaucoma and becomes relocalized to synapses in the adult IPL before significant synapse loss and RGC death.

claims.statement: C1q is upregulated and relocalized to synapses in the adult retina at early stages of glaucoma.

evidence_spans.content: C1q puncta colocalize with synaptic puncta in the IPL of glaucomatous retinas.

provenance.text_excerpt: Confocal imaging revealed that many C1q-positive puncta colocalized with synaptic puncta in the IPL of retinas from DBA/2J mice, and this synaptic localization of C1q was similar to our findings in the IPL of postnatal retinas (Figure 7Bg).

experiments_or_tasks: Immunostaining for C1q in retinas of DBA/2J glaucoma mice at different ages and disease stages.
Quantitative real-time PCR for C1qA and C1qB RNA levels in retinas.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence
methods.protocol_description: Cryosections of retinas stained with C1q-specific antisera and synaptic markers, imaged by confocal microscopy.

methods.name: Quantitative real-time PCR
methods.protocol_description: RNA extracted from retinas, reverse transcribed, and amplified with primers for C1qA and C1qB.

study_units.name: C1q expression and localization in glaucoma model

provenance.text_excerpt: punctate C1q immunoreactivity was present in the IPL of 11 out of 15 retinas from aged DBA/2J mice (four of four at 6 months and seven of 11 at 10.5 months) (Figure 7Aa).

results.value_raw_text: Punctate C1q immunoreactivity was present in IPL of 11 out of 15 retinas from aged DBA/2J mice (4/4 at 6 months, 7/11 at 10.5 months), but not in young DBA/2J or control mice.

results.metric_name: C1qA and C1qB RNA fold change

provenance.text_excerpt: C1qA and C1qB RNA levels were elevated in five out of ten retinas with no or early glaucoma, and increased up to 25-fold in eyes with moderate glaucoma (Figure 7C).

results.value_raw_text: C1qA and C1qB RNA levels were elevated up to 25-fold in eyes with moderate glaucoma compared to controls.
